title: Scanning Electron Microscopy Imaging for Opaline Silica Single Cell Skeletons
author: Miguel Mendez Sandin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ug9etz6

steps.title: Recover Skeleton
steps.instruction: Recover the skeleton from the eluted pellet using binoculars or an inverted microscope.

substeps.instruction: During DNA extraction, dilute waste (pellet debris containing the skeleton) in milliQ water

steps.title: Rinse Skeleton
steps.instruction: Rinse the skeleton several times in milli-Q water to reduce the concentration of SDS and other lysis and DNA precipitation reagents.

steps.title: Treat with Hydrogen Peroxide
steps.instruction: Transfer the skeleton into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes containing 50 µl of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2).

steps.title: Remove Organic Matter
steps.instruction: Heat the sample at 70°C for 10 min to remove residual organic matter.

steps.title: Final Rinse
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of milli-Q water, then handpick the skeleton under binoculars or an inverted microscope and repeat several rinsing steps.

steps.title: Mount for SEM
steps.instruction: Transfer the skeleton onto a glued SEM pin stub mount using as little water as possible.

substeps.instruction: Place the skeleton directly in the glue of the pin stub
Do not use a polycarbonate membrane
